preconditions.detail: family's submission contract must already require, or be extendable to require, more than one file with a declared coupling between them

operators.constructionDelta: Split the single submission/subject.mjs contract into two or more files with an explicit cross-file invariant the verifier checks (not just that both files exist, that their combined behavior satisfies one obligation neither file alone can).
operators.staysFixed: The scenario space, mutant bank, verifier logic, and every rule code in SPEC.md.

excludedSubstrates.reason: every other routable family's contract is a single submission/subject.mjs file today; checker-required-memory-poisoning is the only one already requiring two coupled files (subject.mjs + checker.mjs), so it is the only substrate with a natural baseline (a hypothetical single-file variant) close at hand.
